limitations: message-level writable privilege is potential, not proof of account mutation
failed transactions retain fees; only a resolved different fee payer permits a failed writable tx to be nonblocking for this mint
snapshot candidates are not fetched and do not establish state or transaction effects
no event, sibling-instruction, lifecycle, rent, settlement, or economic qualification
no archive availability or provider completeness claim

policy.failed_transaction_rule: failed tx blocks unless meta.err proves failure and fee payer resolves to an account other than the mint; transaction fees persist on failure
policy.other_transaction_rule: enumerate every same-slot message with mint writable potential in transaction order, including static and loaded writable accounts
policy.snapshot_state: whole account existence, owner, lamports, and raw data bytes
policy.target_gate: candidate transaction success; frozen base mint resolved in target message; mint globally readonly; fee payer resolved and not mint

scope: the exact 140 successful T22-base identities and 16 receipt-hash-bound full blocks from the frozen c4 13:00Z frame
